description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Bloom Tender.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Bloom Tender.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Bloom Tender.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Bloom Tender.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Bloom Tender from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.
